verdict.rationale: Letta's documented memory model is file/Markdown-based (MemFS, memory blocks, persona/human blocks) rather than a graph structure with configurable entity types, edge types, or ontology; no evidence pack item describes defining or customizing a graph schema for memory. Community commentary even confirms memory is 'primarily text/files based' rather than graph-structured (letta-comm-7), so this specific capability is not evidenced.
